# Display snippets for docs/sklearn.md

--8<-- [start:term_constructors]
# Destructure a dataset
load_dataset("iris", D), D is ("Dataset", X, Y)

# Destructure a fitted model
fit(Est("svc", {}), D, F), F is ("Fitted", E, H)
--8<-- [end:term_constructors]

--8<-- [start:algorithm_examples]
# Check that random_forest is a classifier
algorithm("random_forest", "classifier")

# Enumerate all regressors
algorithm(ALGO, "regressor")
--8<-- [end:algorithm_examples]

--8<-- [start:data_loading_examples]
# Load and split iris
load_dataset("iris", D),
split_data(D, 0.2, 42, S),
S is ("Split", TRAIN, TEST)

# Synthetic classification data
make_dataset("classification",
            {"n_samples": 200, "n_features": 5, "random_state": 42},
            D)
--8<-- [end:data_loading_examples]

--8<-- [start:fit_predict_examples]
# Classification workflow
load_dataset("iris", D),
fit(Est("random_forest", {"n_estimators": 100}), D, F),
D is ("Dataset", X, Y),
predict(F, X, PREDS)

# PCA transform
load_dataset("iris", D),
D is ("Dataset", X, Y),
fit(Est("pca", {"n_components": 2}), ("Dataset", X, None), F),
transform(F, X, REDUCED)
--8<-- [end:fit_predict_examples]

--8<-- [start:scoring_examples]
# score a classifier
score(F, D, S), S > 0.9

# 3-fold cross-validation
cross_val_score(Est("logistic_regression", {"max_iter": 200}),
              D, 3, SCORES)

# Multi-metric CV
cross_validate(Est("logistic_regression", {"max_iter": 200}),
              D, 3, ["accuracy", "f1_weighted"], R)
--8<-- [end:scoring_examples]

--8<-- [start:pipeline_example]
pipeline([("scaler", Est("standard_scaler", {})),
          ("clf", Est("logistic_regression", {"max_iter": 200}))],
         PIPE),
load_dataset("iris", D),
fit(PIPE, D, F),
score(F, D, S)
--8<-- [end:pipeline_example]

--8<-- [start:grid_search_example]
load_dataset("iris", D),
grid_search(Est("svc", {}),
           {"C": [0.1, 1.0, 10.0], "kernel": ["rbf", "linear"]},
           D, 3, BEST),
best_params(BEST, PARAMS),
best_score(BEST, SCORE)
--8<-- [end:grid_search_example]

--8<-- [start:learned_example]
fit(Est("random_forest", {"n_estimators": 10}), D, F),
learned(F, "feature_importances", FI)
--8<-- [end:learned_example]

--8<-- [start:complete_workflow]
-import_from(sklearn, [Est, Dataset, Fitted, Split,
                       load_dataset, split_data, fit, predict, score,
                       confusion_matrix, learned])

% Load, split, train, evaluate
IrisWorkflow(SCORE, IMPORTANCES) <- (
    load_dataset("iris", D),
    split_data(D, 0.2, 42, S),
    S is ("Split", TRAIN, TEST),
    fit(Est("random_forest", {"n_estimators": 100, "random_state": 42}),
        TRAIN, F),
    score(F, TEST, SCORE),
    learned(F, "feature_importances", IMPORTANCES)
)
--8<-- [end:complete_workflow]

--8<-- [start:pipeline_grid_search]
-import_from(sklearn, [Est, load_dataset, pipeline, fit, score,
                       grid_search, best_params, best_score])

SearchBestPipeline(PARAMS, SCORE) <- (
    load_dataset("iris", D),
    pipeline([("scaler", Est("standard_scaler", {})),
              ("clf", Est("svc", {}))],
             PIPE),
    grid_search(PIPE,
               {"clf__C": [0.1, 1.0, 10.0],
                "clf__kernel": ["rbf", "linear"]},
               D, 5, "accuracy", BEST),
    best_params(BEST, PARAMS),
    best_score(BEST, SCORE)
)
--8<-- [end:pipeline_grid_search]
